performance_status: No catalogue strategy has been backtested or shown profitable in this task. All performance estimates remain null.
scope: 320 records across 33 families: 302 trading hypotheses and 18 supporting model, execution, or risk-filter entries. 200 new records concern memecoin trading, including 197 hypotheses. Related variants are labeled; these are not 302 independent proven edges.

trend.name: Trend and momentum
trend.data: completed OHLCV bars; executable bid/ask quotes; session calendar
trend.failure: Whipsaws, late entries, crowded trends and reversal gaps can erase the edge.

breakout.name: Breakout and volatility expansion
breakout.data: completed OHLCV bars; historical ranges; bid/ask quotes; session calendar
breakout.failure: False breaks, opening spread expansion and stop slippage can dominate outcomes.

reversion.name: Mean reversion and reversal
reversion.data: completed OHLCV bars; bid/ask quotes; optional market/sector series
reversion.regime: range or temporary dislocation with a stable reference
reversion.failure: A new trend or genuine repricing can keep prices far from the assumed mean.

relative.name: Relative value and cross-asset signals
relative.data: synchronized multi-instrument quotes and bars; borrow/financing data; point-in-time universe
relative.horizon: minutes to one session; longer horizons require separate approval
relative.failure: Relationship breaks, hedge error, asynchronous quotes and one-leg fills create losses.

event.name: Events, catalysts and timing
event.data: publication and receipt timestamps; licensed event/news feed; executable quotes; session and halt status
event.regime: verifiable public event with adequate liquidity
event.failure: The market may already price the event; late, revised or misclassified news creates false signals.

orderflow.name: Order flow and microstructure
orderflow.data: sequenced L2 or L3 feed; trades with reliable aggressor labeling; receipt timestamps; order acknowledgments
orderflow.failure: Queue uncertainty, cancellation, adverse selection and latency overwhelm weak forecasts.

arbitrage.name: Arbitrage, basis and carry
arbitrage.data: synchronized executable depth on every leg; inventory; financing; fee tiers; transfers; contract specifications
arbitrage.regime: executable mispricing larger than all costs and stressed residual risk
arbitrage.horizon: seconds to hours; some carry trades are not day trades
arbitrage.failure: Apparent spreads can reflect capital barriers, stale prices, funding flips, settlement and venue default risk.

making.name: Market making and liquidity provision
making.data: L2/L3 replay; queue and latency model; inventory; fees/rebates; hedging quotes
making.regime: stable two-sided liquidity with controlled inventory
making.horizon: continuous quoting with short inventory horizons
making.failure: Spread capture is offset by adverse selection, inventory drift and hedge costs.

ml.name: Machine learning and adaptive models
ml.data: point-in-time features and labels; reproducible training partitions; executable cost/fill data
ml.regime: must be learned on training data and evaluated chronologically
ml.horizon: determined by labels and achievable execution latency
ml.failure: Leakage, multiple testing, calibration failure and regime drift can create impressive but non-tradable forecasts.

execution.name: Execution and allocation methods
execution.data: approved parent order; live quotes/depth; fill and cancel acknowledgments; account limits
execution.regime: an independently approved investment or risk-reduction decision already exists
execution.failure: These methods control implementation, not expected investment return; urgency and passive fills trade off.

patterns.name: Discretionary pattern formalizations
patterns.data: point-in-time bars; causally confirmed pivots; objective pattern labels; executable quotes
patterns.regime: depends on a frozen, reproducible definition
patterns.failure: Subjective labels, hindsight pivots and flexible exceptions often make these ideas unfalsifiable.

launch_discovery.name: Launch demand discovery
launch_discovery.data: creation events; decoded swaps; real and virtual reserves; buyer clusters; token age
launch_discovery.regime: observable launch with verified exits and sufficient outside demand
launch_discovery.failure: Sybil activity, unknown controls, and rapid inventory dumping
launch_discovery.horizon: Intraday experiment only; define a maximum wall-clock holding horizon before testing.
